findings.text: When removing multiple matching calls from ExpectedCalls, the loop index i is not adjusted after splice removal, causing every second matching call to be skipped. With two consecutive identical mock expectations, only the first gets removed and the second remains, breaking test cleanup.

0.reason: The finding describes the exact same root cause: iterating over ExpectedCalls with the original index while using append(slice[:i], slice[i+1:]...) to remove elements, which skips adjacent matches and can cause out-of-range panics.
